say:1:1230518001:1.text: Nara's orders... requisitioned by the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:1:1230518001:1.source_cn: 是奈拉大姐头……死潮舰队征调的。
say:1:1230518001:1.male: Nara's orders... requisitioned by the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:1:1230518001:1.female: Nara's orders... requisitioned by the Dead Tide Fleet.

say:2:1230518002:1.text: The boss says as long as we toe the line she'll get us everything we need! Food, drink, freedom, you name it!
say:2:1230518002:1.source_cn: 大姐头说，只要我们听话，不管吃的喝的还是自由，统统都给我们！
say:2:1230518002:1.male: The boss says as long as we toe the line she'll get us everything we need! Food, drink, freedom, you name it!
say:2:1230518002:1.female: The boss says as long as we toe the line she'll get us everything we need! Food, drink, freedom, you name it!

say:3:1230518003:1.text: And so far she hasn't lied—I'm loving life with the Water Wights! But now, these weapons are all useless... what a waste!
say:3:1230518003:1.source_cn: 她说得没错，我在水鬼帮待得挺开心，想干什么就干什么！可...
say:3:1230518003:1.male: And so far she hasn't lied—I'm loving life with the Water Wights! But now, these weapons are all useless... what a waste!
say:3:1230518003:1.female: And so far she hasn't lied—I'm loving life with the Water Wights! But now, these weapons are all useless... what a waste!
